featured.title: USCIS Says Your Green Card Application Is Now 'Extraordinary Relief.' That Word Does the Heavy Lifting
featured.excerpt: A policy memo reclassifies adjustment of status from a routine pathway to a discretionary favour, potentially forcing hundreds of thousands of applicants — many of them Indian — to leave the country and apply from abroad.
featured.image_caption: A USCIS Application Support Center in Jamaica, Queens, New York
featured.nri_angle: Indian H-1B holders have relied on adjustment of status for decades to avoid the consular processing gauntlet — this memo threatens that pathway at the worst possible time, with consulate backlogs in India stretching into 2027.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi Lands in New Zealand Tomorrow for the First Time in Forty Years. He Brings a Trade Deal. The Country Brings a Reckoning.
news.excerpt: The India-NZ FTA eliminates tariffs on 100 per cent of Indian exports and locks in thousands of skilled migrants annually. But 'butter chicken tsunami' remarks and racist graffiti in Auckland are the backdrop nobody can ignore.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi meets New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon at Hyderabad House, New Delhi, March 2025
news.nri_angle: The FTA opens skilled migration pathways and duty-free market access for Indian professionals and exporters, while the anti-Indian backlash in New Zealand directly affects the 250,000-strong Indian community.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Google Just Told an Indian Court Its Ad Ruling Makes India the 'Sole Outlier' in the World. The $4.1 Billion Fight Has Begun.
news.excerpt: The Delhi High Court found Google liable for letting rivals bid on Hindware's brand name as a keyword. Google's 4,761-page appeal says the ruling will give trademark holders a monopoly over advertising space.
news.image_caption: Google headquarters at the Googleplex campus in Mountain View, California
news.nri_angle: The ruling could reshape how Google's ad platform works in India, affecting the thousands of Indian-origin tech professionals who work on these systems and the Indian businesses that depend on keyword advertising to compete.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi Told a Packed Melbourne Arena He'd Made a 'Hat-Trick.' Outside, Anti-Indian Protesters Were Waiting.

nri-world.title: Indian Americans Gave Up to Five Billion Dollars Last Year. The Community's Philanthropy Gap Is Finally Closing.

nri-world.nri_angle: For years, the Indian American community — despite being the highest-earning ethnic group in the US — was known for a stubborn philanthropy gap. This new data shows that gap is finally closing, driven by organised giving campaigns, generational shifts, and a growing sense that giving back is integral to diaspora identity. The trend matters to every NRI navigating the dual pull of contributing to both American and Indian causes.

travel.nri_angle: NRIs making quick trips to India — a weekend wedding, a document run, a short family visit — can now book genuinely cheaper tickets by skipping checked bags and meals they didn't need anyway.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: India's Jet Fuel Just Got Cheaper — So Why Aren't Airfares Falling?
travel.excerpt: Aviation turbine fuel prices dropped ₹5 per litre from July 1, and the government pledged a ₹100 billion support package. But for NRIs booking flights to India, the savings haven't shown up in ticket prices yet.
travel.image_caption: An Indian commercial aircraft at a terminal — aviation turbine fuel accounts for up to 40 per cent of airline costs in India
travel.nri_angle: Fuel costs account for up to 60 percent of airline operating expenses on India routes — but despite a historic fuel price correction, NRIs are still seeing stubbornly high fares on key corridors like SFO-DEL and JFK-BOM.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Modi Lands in New Zealand Tomorrow for the First Time in Forty Years. He Brings a Trade Deal. The Country Brings a Reckoning.
carousel.excerpt: The India-NZ FTA eliminates tariffs on 100 per cent of Indian exports and locks in thousands of skilled migrants annually. But 'butter chicken tsunami' remarks and racist graffiti in Auckland are the backdrop nobody can ignore.
carousel.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi meets New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon at Hyderabad House, New Delhi, March 2025
carousel.nri_angle: The FTA opens skilled migration pathways and duty-free market access for Indian professionals and exporters, while the anti-Indian backlash in New Zealand directly affects the 250,000-strong Indian community.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Ram Charan's Peddi Just Landed on Netflix. Here's Why the Diaspora Should Pay Attention.
carousel.excerpt: After a ₹340 crore theatrical run that dominated Andhra Pradesh but stumbled everywhere else, the three-hour Telugu sports epic gets its second chance — and for NRIs who missed it in cinemas, this is the version that matters.

carousel.title: 212 Years of Lord's. Zero Women's Tests. Until Friday.
carousel.excerpt: England and India will play the first-ever women's Test at the Home of Cricket, 50 years after Rachael Heyhoe-Flint led the first women's match at the ground.
carousel.image_caption: Lord's Cricket Ground in London, set to host its first women's Test match in its 212-year history (Wikimedia Commons)
carousel.nri_angle: The first women's Test at Lord's gives NRIs in the UK a historic chance to watch India's women at cricket's most iconic venue, correcting a 212-year exclusion.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Google Just Broke Ground on Its Biggest AI Hub Outside America. The Location: Vizag.
carousel.excerpt: Sundar Pichai's $15 billion bet on Visakhapatnam will bring gigawatt-scale compute, three subsea cables, and a new digital corridor between India and the United States.
carousel.image_caption: Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai at a 2023 event
carousel.nri_angle: Indian Americans at Google and other Big Tech firms will work on AI systems powered by Vizag's compute. NRIs from Andhra Pradesh watch their home state become a global tech hub.

carousel.title: TCS Beats Revenue Estimates as AI Business Crosses $2.6 Billion — What NRI Investors Should Know
carousel.excerpt: India's largest IT exporter posted 14% revenue growth, restarted hiring after three years, and expanded partnerships with Anthropic and Mistral. The dividend cheque lands July 31.

carousel.nri_angle: TCS is one of the largest H-1B employers and a cornerstone holding for NRI investors. The $2.6B AI revenue run rate, dividend declaration, and hiring restart all directly impact diaspora portfolios and career prospects.
